summary.ru: Поздняя Лян — одно из 16 варварских государств, на которые распался в IV веке Северный Китай. Существовало в 386—403 годах.
summary.en: The Later Liang was a dynastic state of China and one of the Sixteen Kingdoms in Chinese history. It was founded by the Lü family of the Di ethnicity and given the prefix of "Later" in historiography to distinguish it with the Former Liang dynasty before them and the three Liang states that emerged during their collapse.
